P00-AC-01.requirement: Exact identities are authenticated and recorded.
P00-AC-01.minimum_evidence: Exact-identity JSON binds target repo/head/tree, legacy repo/head/tree/schema, snapshot SHA/bytes, plan, review, branch, and worktree.

P00-AC-02.requirement: The logical PostgreSQL target identity is my_pa.
P00-AC-02.minimum_evidence: Target identity record and semantic validation assert my_pa; no database access occurs.

P00-AC-03.requirement: The legacy SQLite source is documented as read-only and its rename or mutation remains unauthorized.
P00-AC-03.minimum_evidence: Source-read-only declaration binds the historical filename and explicitly denies access, rename, and mutation.

P00-AC-04.requirement: Implementation is not self-authorized and no successor work item is automatically activated.
P00-AC-04.minimum_evidence: Authorization ledger records explicit operator activation; successor remains inactive; implementation response stops for independent review.

P00-AC-05.requirement: The migration goal, phase, and work-item structure is published and internally consistent.
P00-AC-05.minimum_evidence: Goal charter/state, work-item ledger, authorization ledger, acceptance register, evidence index, and semantic checks agree.

excluded_criteria.P00-AC-06: Belongs to WP-P00-02. Not authorized, not implemented, not evidenced by this work item.
excluded_criteria.P00-AC-07: Belongs to WP-P00-02. Not authorized, not implemented, not evidenced by this work item.
excluded_criteria.P00-AC-08: Belongs to WP-P00-02. Not authorized, not implemented, not evidenced by this work item.

acceptance_rule: A criterion may be marked PASS only with evidence tied to the exact implementation head. An assertion, a draft, or a passing unrelated test is not sufficient. Any later commit invalidates every criterion result and the independent review bound to it.
self_acceptance_prohibited: The implementing agent records demonstrated evidence only. Final acceptance is determined by independent review.
